caption: The video captures a sunset over a calm sea, a bright orange-yellow sun disk resting on the flat horizon. The sky grades from deep orange at the horizon to muted gray-brown overhead, with a faint landmass left and a thin structure right. A vertical column of shimmering reflection stretches down the water toward the foreground, broken into flickering segments as the surface ripples. The sea shows continuous small wavelets, their crests shifting subtly over time, modulating the brightness and shape of the reflected column. In the darker foreground, a separate small orange reflection patch re-forms with the moving water. The sun and horizon remain essentially stationary, and occasional tiny dark specks appear briefly in the upper sky. The composition stays fixed as the light on the water keeps shimmering.
